events.author: Solver
events.name: Christianity Founded

options.text: We will seek an understanding with the adherents of [religion].

events.text: In a reminder that the threads of fate sometimes interweave in surprising ways, a newly founded religious movement called [religion] is now centered in the [rival] city of [city]. It cannot escape notice that [religion] bears similarity to practices that have recently developed within our own nation. It is [city] that will be known as the sacred center of [religion], but these similarities give us every reason to hope for good relations with the leaders of this newly established religion.
